neighbours.label: main verb that resumes a sentence after a subject interrupted by a dash or comma aside
fire: Newer apple types - in many ways quite like the old ones - have not sold as well.
A simple report on your energy use – compared to your neighbours – can change habits.
The council, after weeks of fierce debate, passed the budget on Friday.
The captain, who was barely a mile away, made a run for the harbour.
The orchard, planted with seeds from the northern valley, produced a fine crop.
My grandmother – never one to complain – kept working until eighty.
The committee, despite strong objections from members, approved the merger.
The old engine - rebuilt twice since the war - still runs every summer.
